timing: Specified after seeing color and parcel results. Animal-task outcomes and carrier measurements had not been collected or inspected. The animal task is the independent test for this refinement. The earlier tasks provide training or exploratory comparisons.
primary: Paired centered R2 gain of a carrier-vector predictor plus a fitted source correction over the original relevance-conditioned source ridge on 48 fresh animal pairs, for 9B and 4B separately. Keep all clean and carrier failures; report gains and absolute R2.
prototype: For each eligible answer word, run one neutral instruction: Repeat exactly this lowercase word: WORD. Capture the clean final residual at the first-answer prediction site using the same chat format. Use donor-minus-original carrier differences. No paired task outcome or edited test activation enters a carrier. Report carrier top-1 accuracy and additional forward passes.
fit: On original color training only, fit one scalar per query relation mapping the carrier difference to the final edit response. Add a ridge correction from the original source delta to the remaining response, selecting its penalty with the original five prefix folds. Also report scalar carrier alone and a predictor that shares its scalar across both queries. Use unchanged coefficients and original color fits for every evaluation. No animal or parcel task rows in training.
additional: Transfer control package from the earlier parcel study. Norm-matched random edit on each animal pair. No head screen on animal data. Record all raw arrays, tokens, margins and top-1 outcomes.
